SCCN Boot Camp I

October 13–15, 2002

SCCN researchers will give 4 hours of talks and tutorials as an introduction for students interested in working on EEG analysis projects at SCCN.

Times and dates:

Oct. 13 3:00-4:00pm Tzyy-Ping Jung, "Independent Component Analysis"

Oct. 13 4:15-5:15 Scott Makeig, "Event-related Brain Dynamics"

Oct. 14 2:30-3:30 Arnaud Delorme, "Analyzing data with EEGLAB"

Oct. 15 10:30-12:00 Arnaud Delorme, "Advanced analysis using EEGLAB"

Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience
Institute for Neural Computation, UC San Diego
9500 Gilman Drive # 0559, La Jolla, CA 92093-0559
Office: 858-822-7534 · Fax: 858-822-7556
